node.title: Re: use Perl to construct web page
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Is Perl still a viable option to construct an interactive web page?

Yes! These recent threads should give you plenty of information:

  • [id://1182902]
  • [id://1185731]

Much of the dynamic nature of modern websites comes from JavaScript in the browser, to that end there are several libraries, the one I usually reach for is [http://jquery.com/|jQuery]. But Perl is still very well suited to handle the server side.
